title: Buy something (in store, phone)
start_push: Just check the price. That's all for now.

first_time_question.text: Have you paid with your phone at a store before?

steps.text: Find the price and read it

picture.alt: A price tag on a shelf under an item

tips: Can't find it? Look at the aisle signs, or ask a store worker

steps.text: Check you have enough money for this
Ask yourself if you need this right now
Look at one other option, then stop looking

picture.alt: Two price tags side by side with the unit price circled

tips: Buying your usual item, or already decided (it's on your list)? You can skip this step
Same item in different sizes? The shelf tag or listing may show price per ounce. Lower is cheaper. You can take a photo and ask

steps.text: Decide: buy it, or leave it for now
tips: Can't decide? You can choose your usual, or leave it for now and come back later

steps.text: Take it to the register and wait your turn
tips: Self-checkout? Follow the screen to scan your item, then pay

steps.text: Look at the total on the card reader

picture.alt: A card reader screen showing the total

substeps.text: Check it matches what you expected
Tell the cashier if it doesn't

steps.safety: Never tell anyone your phone passcode. Only hold your phone near the store's card reader.

picture.alt: The top of a phone held near a card reader

iphone_face_id.text: Hold the top of your phone near the reader

iphone_home_button.text: Rest your finger on the button
Hold the top of your phone near the reader

android.text: Hold the back of your phone near the reader
If the reader asks for a PIN, follow the screen

tips: Payment didn't go through? Try once more, pay with your card, or ask the cashier

steps.text: Take your receipt and put it away

_levels_note: No short names (Nov 4). Some help shows the step's full 'text' with no small steps. Most help shows 'text' plus small steps, one at a time.
_safety_note: 'safety' is shown on the step as a CAUTION line at every help level, even when folded. Always visible (Nov 4).
_media_note: picture: simple SVG of the action (ours). Generic readers, phones and screens only: never a real card, card number, bank app or receipt. video: null until a free-license clip is added and credited.
